title: Protocol
description: The WebSocket protocol between the app and the go-server: for every request type its request and response. The single source for the TypeScript types (npm run generate:protocol) and checked against the real server in go-server/integration_test.go.

tile.description: Tile chosen in the add-on (ReGa metadata)

Channel.description: A channel as ReGa knows it, with its current values

GetChannelsRequest.description: Channels of a room, a trade, a favorite list or (all) of all devices

SubscribeRequest.description: Events for these channels (replacing the previous list)

ErrorResponse.description: A failed request; requestId if the request had one

EventMessage.description: A value reported by the CCU for a subscribed channel

RadioInterface.description: A radio module with its duty cycle (percent of the allowed transmit time used)

ServiceMessage.description: An active service message of the CCU

type.description: The datapoint that raised it, e.g. STICKY_UNREACH

url.description: Where to download the backup, once and within 5 minutes

active.description: Whether the alarm variable is still set

Favorite.description: A favorite list of the CCU user

tile.description: The tile shown for the channel; empty lets the app decide

ProgramDefinition.description: A program with its WENN / SONST WENN rules and the SONST branch

leftType.description: ivtObjectId, ivtSystemId, ivtCurrentDate, ivtEmpty or N:<number>

param.description: ivtObjectId, ivtSystemId, ivtString (script), ivtEmpty or N:<number>

InterfaceLink.description: A direct link and the interface it belongs to

endpoint.description: the device's push endpoint, if subscribed

time.description: the CCU's local time, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

canPower.description: whether reboot and shutdown work (the add-on runs on the CCU)

fullName.description: login name without spaces; first name up to the first space, as in the WebUI

password.description: only to set it; the WebUI's allowed characters

showLogin.description: shown on the WebUI's login page

HistoryEntry.description: One entry of the system protocol (dom.GetHistoryData)

group.description: entries of one event share a group

text.description: the value as the WebUI writes it (system variables)

latest.description: the newest version the add-on's update URL names

Addon.description: An add-on as its rc.d script describes itself (cp_software.cgi)

newPassword.description: the WebUI's allowed characters, not empty

ProgramUsage.description: A program using channels of a device (ChnEnumDPUsagePrograms)

VirtualKey.description: A virtual key of the CCU (HM-RCV-50, HmIP-RCV-50)

programs.description: how many programs use the key
